Natarajan Chandrasekaran to step down as Tata Sons Chairman in 2027

Natarajan Chandrasekaran will step down as Chairman of Tata Sons in February 2027. He was appointed in 2017 and is the first non-family member to lead the conglomerate. His tenure saw the acquisition of Air India and significant investment plans. The announcement has led to discussions about the future leadership and the relationship between Tata Sons and Tata Trusts. Some reports indicate Tata Group stocks experienced mixed reactions following the news.
